questions.subject: Igbo
questions.learningObjective: Chọpụta aha na ngwaa site n’ọrụ ha n’ahịrịokwu.
questions.prompt: Gụọ ahịrịokwu a: “Nneka sachara ite ahụ.” Kewaa okwu ndị a n’òtù okwu ha: Nneka, sachara, ite. Kọwaa ọrụ okwu nke abụọ n’ahịrịokwu ahụ.
questions.answer: Nneka bụ aha mmadụ. Sachara bụ ngwaa. Ite bụ aha ihe. Sachara na-egosi ihe Nneka mere ite ahụ.
questions.explanation: Aha ndị ahụ na-akpọ mmadụ na ihe. Ngwaa ahụ na-egosi omume e mere.

markingGuide.description: Mata Nneka dị ka aha mmadụ.
Mata ite dị ka aha ihe.
Kọwaa na sachara na-egosi omume Nneka.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.learningObjective: Jiri nnọchiaha dochie aha mmadụ mgbe ihe ọ na-anọchi doro anya.
questions.prompt: Gụọ: “Chika gara ahịa. Chika zụtara ji.” Dee ahịrịokwu nke abụọ ọzọ ka e jiri nnọchiaha dochie Chika. Kwuo onye nnọchiaha ahụ na-anọchi.
questions.answer: Ọ zụtara ji. Ọ na-anọchi Chika.
questions.explanation: Ahịrịokwu mbụ ekwupụtala onye a na-ekwu maka ya. N’ahịrịokwu nke abụọ, “Ọ” na-anọchi aha Chika.

markingGuide.description: Debe ihe Chika zụtara na omume ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.learningObjective: Tụnyere isi ngwaa na aha e si na ya nweta.
questions.prompt: Tụlee “gụọ” n’ahịrịokwu “Gụọ akwụkwọ a” na “ọgụgụ” n’ahịrịokwu “Ọgụgụ na-atọ Ada ụtọ.” Kedu nke bụ aha omume? Kedu isi ngwaa e ji mepụta aha ahụ? Kọwaa ọdịiche dị n’ọrụ okwu abụọ ahụ.
questions.answer: Ọgụgụ bụ aha omume. Isi ngwaa ya bụ gụ. N’ahịrịokwu mbụ, gụọ na-enye iwu ka mmadụ gụọ akwụkwọ. N’ahịrịokwu nke abụọ, ọgụgụ bụ aha ihe na-atọ Ada ụtọ.
questions.explanation: Okwu abụọ ahụ metụtara otu omume. Ụdị ngwaa na-enye iwu, ebe aha ahụ na-akpọ omume ahụ aha.

markingGuide.description: Mata ọgụgụ dị ka aha omume.
Nye gụ dị ka isi ngwaa.
Kọwaa ọrụ gụọ dị ka iwu.
Kọwaa ọrụ ọgụgụ dị ka aha omume Ada nwere mmasị na ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.learningObjective: Kọwaa otú okwu abụọ si jikọta nye otu aha.
questions.prompt: N’ahịrịokwu “Ụgbọelu rutere n’Enugwu,” kewaa ụgbọelu ụzọ abụọ. Kọwaa otú akụkụ abụọ ahụ si enye aka n’ịghọta ihe okwu ahụ pụtara.
questions.answer: Ụgbọelu sitere n’ụgbọ na elu. Ụgbọ na-egosi ihe e ji eme njem. Elu na-egosi ebe ọ na-aga. Mgbe e jikọtara ha, ụgbọelu bụ ụgbọ na-efe n’elu ikuku.
questions.explanation: Akụkụ abụọ ahụ na-enye ihe ngosi banyere ihe e ji eme njem na ebe ọ na-agagharị.

markingGuide.description: Nye ụgbọ dị ka akụkụ mbụ.
Nye elu dị ka akụkụ nke abụọ.
Kọwaa ọrụ ụgbọ n’ịpụta ihe e ji eme njem.
